text_en: Comfort, O comfort my people, says your God.
text_cn: “你们安慰，安慰我的百姓吧！” 你们的天主说。

text_en: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and cry to her that she has served her term, that her penalty is paid, that she has received from the Lord ’s hand double for all her sins.
text_cn: 你们应向耶路撒冷说宽心的话，并向她宣告：她的苦役已满期，她的罪债已清偿，因为她为了自己的一切罪过，已由上主手中承受了双倍的惩罚。

text_en: A voice cries out: “In the wilderness prepare the way of the Lord , make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
text_cn: 有一个呼声喊说：“你们要在旷野中预备上主的道路，在荒原中为我们的天主修平一条大路！

text_en: Every valley shall be lifted up, and every mountain and hill be made low; the uneven ground shall become level, and the rough places a plain.
text_cn: 一切深谷要填满，一切山陵要铲平，隆起的要削为平地，崎岖的要辟成坦途！

text_en: Then the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all people shall see it together, for the mouth of the Lord has spoken. ”
text_cn: 上主的光荣要显示出来，凡有血肉的都会看见：这是上主亲口说的。”

text_en: A voice says, “Cry out! ” And I said, “What shall I cry? ” All people are grass, their constancy is like the flower of the field.
text_cn: 有个声音说：“呼喊罢！”我答说：“我呼喊什么？”“凡有血肉的都似草，他的美丽似田野的花；

text_en: The grass withers, the flower fades, when the breath of the Lord blows upon it; surely the people are grass.
text_cn: 上主的风吹来，草必枯萎，花必凋谢。【的确，人民好像草。】

text_en: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God will stand forever.
text_cn: 草能枯萎，花能凋谢，但我们天主的话永远常存。”

text_en: Get you up to a high mountain, O Zion, herald of good tidings; lift up your voice with strength, O Jerusalem, herald of good tidings, lift it up, do not fear; say to the cities of Judah, “Here is your God! ”
text_cn: 给熙雍传喜讯的啊！请登上高山！给耶路撒冷报喜讯的啊！请大声疾呼！高呼吧！不要畏惧！向犹大各城报告说：你们的天主来了！

text_en: See, the Lord God comes with might, and his arm rules for him; his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
text_cn: 吾主上主带着威能来到，他的手臂获得了胜利；他的胜利品与他同在，他获得的酬劳在他面前。

text_en: He will feed his flock like a shepherd; he will gather the lambs in his arms, and carry them in his bosom, and gently lead the mother sheep.
text_cn: 他必如牧人，牧放自己的羊群，以自己的手臂集合小羊，把它们抱在自己的怀中，温良地领导哺乳的母羊。

text_en: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand and marked off the heavens with a span, enclosed the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales and the hills in a balance?
text_cn: 谁曾用手心量过海水，用手掌测量过天，用升斗量过地上的尘土，用天秤称过高山，用戥（děng）子秤过丘陵呢？

text_en: Who has directed the spirit of the Lord , or as his counselor has instructed him?
text_cn: 谁曾指挥过上主的心灵；或做过他的参谋，教导过他呢？

text_en: Whom did he consult for his enlightenment, and who taught him the path of justice? Who taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
text_cn: 他曾向谁请教过，请他教导自己，指导自己正路，教授自己知识，指示明智的行径呢？

text_en: Even the nations are like a drop from a bucket, and are accounted as dust on the scales; see, he takes up the isles like fine dust.
text_cn: 看哪！万民像桶中的一滴水，如天秤上的一粒沙；看，岛屿重如一粒灰尘。

text_en: Lebanon would not provide fuel enough, nor are its animals enough for a burnt offering.
text_cn: 黎巴嫩不够当柴烧，其中的野兽不足作燔祭。

text_en: All the nations are as nothing before him; they are accounted by him as less than nothing and emptiness.
text_cn: 万民在他面前好像乌有，在他看来只是空虚净无。

text_en: To whom then will you liken God, or what likeness compare with him?
text_cn: 你们要把天主同谁相比拟呢？你们把他与什么相对照呢？

text_en: An idol? —A workman casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts for it silver chains.
text_cn: 与偶像吗？偶像是工匠铸造，金匠再包上金子，然后再铸银链围起来。

text_en: As a gift one chooses mulberry wood —wood that will not rot— then seeks out a skilled artisan to set up an image that will not topple.
text_cn: 精于选料的人，再选择一块不朽的木头，再寻找一位精明的工匠，将铸像立定，不致倒下。

text_en: Have you not known? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood from the foundations of the earth?
text_cn: 难道你们不知道？难道你们没有听说？难道从起初没有人告诉过你们？难道由大地肇（zhào）基以来你们没有细察过吗？

text_en: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them like a tent to live in;
text_cn: 他坐在大地的穹窿之上，地上的居民有如蝗虫一般。他展开天幕有如帷幔，伸开天空有如居住的蓬帐。

text_en: who brings princes to naught, and makes the rulers of the earth as nothing.
text_cn: 他使王侯化为乌有，叫地上士绅成为虚无。

text_en: Scarcely are they planted, scarcely sown, scarcely has their stem taken root in the earth, when he blows upon them, and they wither, and the tempest carries them off like stubble.
text_cn: 他们刚被栽上，刚被种植，刚在土中扎根，他向他们一嘘气，他们便立即枯萎，暴风卷枯秸似的将他们卷走。

text_en: To whom then will you compare me, or who is my equal? says the Holy One.
text_cn: “你们把我同谁比拟呢？要我与谁相似呢？”圣者如此说。

text_en: Lift up your eyes on high and see: Who created these? He who brings out their host and numbers them, calling them all by name; because he is great in strength, mighty in power, not one is missing.
text_cn: 你们举目向上，看看是谁造了这些呢？是他按照数目展开了他的万军，按照次序一一点名，在这强而有力和威能者前，没有一个敢缺席的。

text_en: Why do you say, O Jacob, and speak, O Israel, “My way is hidden from the Lord , and my right is disregarded by my God”?
text_cn: 雅各伯！你为什么说？以色列！你为什么讲：“上主看不见我的命运！我的天主忽略了我的案件！”

text_en: Have you not known? Have you not heard? The Lord is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He does not faint or grow weary; his understanding is unsearchable.
text_cn: 难道你不知道，或者没有听说：上主是永生的天主，是创造地极之主吗？他总不疲倦，决不困乏，他的智慧高深莫测。

text_en: He gives power to the faint, and strengthens the powerless.
text_cn: 他赐给疲倦者力量，赐给无力者勇气。

text_en: Even youths will faint and be weary, and the young will fall exhausted;
text_cn: 少年人能疲倦困乏，青年人能失足跌倒；

text_en: but those who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength, they shall mount up with wings like eagles, they shall run and not be weary, they shall walk and not faint.
text_cn: 而仰望上主的，必获得新力量，必能振翼高飞有如兀鹰，疾驰而不困乏，奔走而不疲倦。
